draft.emotion: warm and respectful, speaking of one's mother and father with care
notes: Literally the dual of وَالِد (father), used to mean both mother and father. In the accusative and genitive cases it becomes وَالِدَيْنِ (wālidayni), and before a pronoun or noun it drops the final ن (e.g. وَالِدَايَ 'my parents', وَالِدَيَّ).
